title: OnesAndOnlys's God Foods!
description: adds a few unique items and foods to the game!
body:
this mod adds a few unique items and foods to the game!


# WARNING
Please backup your world first before using the beta and alpha version of the mod because it contains many game-breaking bugs.


## Note 
the Fabric port of this mod has been discontinued as of version 6.0B and has switched to Neoforge


# Features

- 8 new unique foods!
- 5 new potion effects!
- balanced recipes
- new uses for useless items!

# Added foods

## 1. Golden steak
this food is a steak but gold, it has the same effects as the golden apple
but with the nutrional value of the steak (a bit better), it restores 10 hunger pints (5 drums).
but it can only be stacked to 32
the recipe is one steak in the middle and gold ingots surrounding it

## 2. Enchanted golden steak
this is golden steak but enchanted, when eaten it gives the potion effect absorption 4 for 2 minutes, regen 2 for 20 seconds, strength 1 for 1 minute, and speed 1 for 1 minute. its basicaly a offensive foccused enchanted golden apple, it can be crafted with a golden steak in the middle, 4 eye of ender in the corners
and 4 exp bottles making a cross and it gives 1 enchanted golden steak. same with the golden steak it can only be stacked to 32

## 3. Cookie with crumbled amethyst
this food is a cookie with crumbled amethyst as a topping, when eaten it gives the potion effect resistance 3 for 10 seconds and spiky for 10 seconds, spiky is a harmful potion effect that damages the entit every second,
it deals 1 point of damage (0.5 hearts) every second. it can be crafted with a cookie and a crumbled amethyst on top of the cookie, crumbled amethyst can be crafted with one amethyst shard and it gives 4 crumbled amethyst.

## 4. Interdimensional potato
this food is a baked potato filled with with smashed chorus fruit, when eaten it gives a potion effect called Chorus overdrive for 
10 seconds, chorus overdrive is a neutral effect that makes the affected entity teleport to a random location within a 20 block radius every second, it can be crafted with a baked potato in the middle and 4 smashed chorus fruit surrounding it, smashed chorus fruit can be crafted with a chorus fruit it gives one smashed chorus fruit.

## 5. Sugar cube
this food is a sugar cube, when eaten it gives a potion effect called sugar rush for 10 second,
sugar rush makes the player move faster by 3x and a very small attack speed boost, but when sugar rush ends it gives a potion effect called sugar crash, sugar crash makes the player very slow and the entity attack speed is reduced too, when the player eats sugary food like sugar cube but still has the sugar rush effect it gives hunger 5 for 10 seconds and when the player eats sugar cube but still has the effect sugar crash it gives sugar crash 2 for 30 seconds and hunger 10 for 20 seconds. sugar cube can be crafted with 4 sugar makinga square.

## 6. Chocolate
this food is a chocolate, it give sugar rush 2 for 20 second, it can be crafted with 2 grinded cocoa at the top left and top mid then 2 sugar cube in the left mid and the mid then 2 grinded cocoa in the left bottom and mid bottom, grinded cocoa can be crafted with 4 roasted cocoa making a square and it gives 2 grinded cocoa, you can get roasted cocoa from cooking cocoa beans with blast furnace.

## 7. Echoing glow berry
this food is a glow berry that been infected by a sculk, when eaten it gives the potion effect Sculk infected, sculk infected makes the entity have the blindness effect for the duration of the effect but mobs in a 30 block radius each 5 second have the glow effect for 2.5 seconds and the sculk infected entity gets a 2x damage multiplier and a 1.5x knockback multiplier. this food can be crafted with a glow berry in the mid and 4 echo shard surrounding it.

## 8. Ghost burger
this food is a burger but ghost, when eaten gives invis for 2 minutes and slow falling for 2 minutes, it can be crafted with 1 bread at the top, a vex soul in the mid and 1 bread at the bottom, you can get vex soul when a vex is killed and its a 100 percent chance.
